reviews.text:
The nurses' attitudes are terrible.

This hospital should be removed from the list of TNR (Trap-Neuter-Return) designated hospitals.

The veterinarians are very kind.

I was shocked to see one nurse leaving the outside door open while the room where the cats were kept was also open.

Either replace the nurses or remove this hospital from the list of TNR designated hospitals!

Thank you for your help on a public holiday.
Early in the morning, my cat became ill, and since it was a public holiday, our regular vet was closed.
I searched online for a hospital near my home that accepts emergencies and called, but they said, "We can't accept appointments."
Feeling anxious and worried, I looked at their website and made an appointment online, even though it was a bit far from my home.
The doctor who examined my cat was just as described: "Thorough examination and easy-to-understand explanations."
I was panicking for a while, but I'm so glad I found this hospital.
Thank you for your help.

It's not a large facility, but the staff and teachers are very friendly, and the atmosphere is great.

The prices are reasonable. I also sympathize with their animal rescue activities.

It's clear they really love animals! 😆😆
I've used their services several times for TNR (Trap-Neuter-Return) of stray cats. They are a very good hospital with reasonable prices, excellent service, and skilled surgeries.

Thank you for your kind feedback.

We will continue to strive to be a clinic that earns the trust of everyone in the community.

We look forward to your next visit.

I continue to use their services even after moving. The clinic director is incredibly trustworthy, providing kind and thorough explanations regarding health checkups, vaccinations, and treatment costs for all seven of my cats. I believe that even human medical professionals need the same kind of personality. They also accept rescue cats for treatment, and I have nothing but respect and gratitude for them. I hope to continue our relationship for another 10, 20 years or more.
I've been a patient here for over a year now. It's a veterinary clinic that provides conscientious care. Thank you for your continued support.
I was so relieved to find a separate examination room for stray cats! I'm not an expert, but the diagnosis was accurate, and my cat was better after just two days thanks to the medicine they gave me!

My beloved cat has been receiving care here for many years. The director is calm and polite, always listening to my questions and concerns, Dr. N always gives clear and precise explanations, and the nursing staff are always kind. As a very anxious pet owner, I will never forget the moment when my cat became ill and I burst into tears, only to be greeted by the nurses who said, "It's okay." Even though it's far from my home, I've decided to continue receiving care here. Thank you so much for everything.

Thank you for visiting our clinic. 
We are pleased to receive such a high rating. 
Please feel free to contact us if you have any further questions.

I used this hospital to have a stray cat spayed or neutered. Besides general veterinary services, this hospital also performs spaying and neutering surgeries on stray dogs and cats at a low cost. It was a great help.
This is the most trustworthy veterinary clinic I've ever been to. The doctors and staff are very kind. The treatments and fees are reasonable, although the wait times are long.

Thank you for submitting your review.

We appreciate you taking the time to provide us with your valuable feedback.

Although it's a little far from my home, I always take my beloved cat here if there's anything wrong with it. The director and other doctors and staff are all very kind. 
I often think about going to a hospital closer to my home, but I feel more at ease knowing that I'll be examined by a trustworthy doctor and staff member, even if it's far away, so I always come here.

Thank you for visiting our clinic.

We are very pleased to receive such a high rating.
The doctors and staff are all very kind. I visited for my cat's treatment, and the explanations were very clear and helpful.

Thank you for visiting our clinic.

We are very pleased to receive such a high rating.

Thank you for visiting our clinic.

We also appreciate your valuable feedback.

I’m a cat shelter volunteer and cat/kitten rescuer. I took a stray cat to Ichi Hospital for a neuter surgery because I support TNR and rescue efforts.

I always rely on you for surgeries on stray cats. 
The doctor is very skilled, but I'm also impressed by the nurses' knowledge and how well they handle stray cats.
